additional_workflows.name: inventory_availability

additional_workflows.name: supplier_trade_funding

additional_workflows.name: store_fulfilment_operations
additional_workflows.purpose: store and fulfilment operational exceptions review

additional_workflows.name: digital_commerce_steering

additional_workflows.prompt_template: Prepare the {period} {purpose} for {company}'s {audience}. Use {sources}. {action_instruction} {output_label} in {destination}. additional_workflows.name: customer_service_recovery
additional_workflows.purpose: customer complaint, service recovery and loyalty risk review
additional_workflows.prompt_template: Prepare the {period} {purpose} for {company}'s {audience}. Use {sources}. {action_instruction} {output_label} in {destination}.
